overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole conducted public interviews for the position of City Clerk and voted to recommend Laurel Siegel for the appointment. The council also recognized the service of the interim clerk during the transition period.

items.title: Final Interviews for City Clerk
items.summary: The committee interviewed finalists Kevin Foley and Laurel Siegel, questioning them on their legal backgrounds, experience with modernization, and plans for the clerk’s office. Both candidates addressed public service, records management, and staff training.

items.title: Deliberation and Recommendation for City Clerk Appointment
items.summary: Councilors discussed the merits of both candidates, weighing their specific clerical and legal experience against the needs of the office and existing city staffing. The committee voted to recommend Laurel Siegel for the position and authorize a formal job offer.

items.title: Recognition of Acting City Clerk
items.summary: The council expressed gratitude to Acting City Clerk Rich Eliseo for his professional service and consistency during the ten-month vacancy in the department.
